definitions.full: H5131. noph נוֺף noun [masculine] elevation, height (Late Hebrew נוֺף is tree-top, bough , so נוֺפָא ᵑ7 ); — נ ׳יְפֵה Psa 48:3 beautiful in elevation (of Mount Zion).
